scale_rule: RMS pairwise block distance over nominal qualified training-source states; no fitted bandwidth

native_followup.entry_cases: Earliest robust 3/3 Fixed A anchor per training source; +/- existing 0.5 mm, 5 mm/s offsets on the other target tangent
native_followup.early_cases: Earliest certified training bridge anchor per source, same two new offsets; record full state/motor trajectory

conditional_training.extension_requires: B gains entry-followed-by-native-qualified-contact over A at >=2 distinct earlier anchors, >=1 robust 3/3 anchor; braking >=32/36 and terminal >=27/30, no retention envelope exits
conditional_training.selection: last common endpoint, sealed before fresh evaluation
conditional_training.heldout_protocol: R3 populations and perturbation magnitudes, independently seeded; no fitting or selection on held-out outcomes
